name: Wizard and the Princess
source:
King George's daughter Priscilla has been kidnapped by an evil wizard named Harlin, who holds her in his castle. The King offers half of his kingdom to anyone who would venture into the faraway mountain land, enter the castle, defeat Harlin, and bring back the princess. Only one adventurer is brave enough to accept this challenge.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/hi-res-adventure-2-the-wizard-and-the-princess]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
乔治国王的女儿普里西拉被一个名叫哈林的邪恶巫师绑架，并把她关在他的城堡里。国王将他一半的王国赠予任何愿意冒险进入遥远山区、进入城堡、击败哈林并带回公主的人。只有一位冒险家有足够的勇气接受这一挑战。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/hi-res-adventure-2-the-wizard-and-the-princess]Mobygames[/url]]
